task.title: Resume a node from maintenance mode by using the CLI
task.shortdesc: You can resume a node from maintenance mode that was initiated with a NodeMaintenance CR by deleting the NodeMaintenance CR.

ul.li: Install the Red Hat OpenShift CLI oc.
Log in to the cluster as a user with cluster-admin privileges.

step.cmd: When your node maintenance task is complete, delete the active NodeMaintenance CR:

ol.li:
Check the progress of the maintenance task by running the following command: $ oc describe node <node-name>
where <node-name> is the name of your node; for example, node-1.example.com
Check the example output: Events: Type Reason Age From Message ---- ------ ---- ---- ------- Normal NodeSchedulable 2m kubelet Node node-1.example.com status is now: NodeSchedulable
